name: 100 Days on Chunk
desc:
The world was torn apart, leaving you stranded on a single chunk above the void...

Gather resources. 🪓

Craft new chunks and items. 🌍

Build your base. 🏰

Survive the nights, raids, and bosses. 🧟‍♂️

Day 100 is waiting... but will you live long enough to see it?

Like & favorite the game for future updates :D👍
